day.headline: A Goat day — Rabbit and Pig are in step.

reasons: Pig and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: one deep breath at the door
signs.message: Breathe once at the door, then walk in like it's yours.

reasons: Goat's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Nobody makes it the way you do. Take the extra minute.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: advice you did not ask for
signs.message: Someone handed you a take you didn't ask for. Try it.

reasons: Rabbit and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the letter you have not opened
signs.message: Open it standing up, right now. It's shorter than your dread.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a party you would leave early
signs.message: Go, stay an hour, leave while you still like everyone.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: traffic on a road you never take
signs.message: Jammed up on a street you never use. Not your problem.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That backup hasn't actually run in months. Kick it off before lunch.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Nothing's late. Do one small thing, the itch quiets down.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That glass has been full since morning. Drink it, slowly.

reasons: Horse pairs with Goat — a harmonious day
signs.message: The first hour home belongs to nobody. Don't fill it.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: two options that are both fine
signs.message: Both work. Quit weighing them, let six o'clock you choose.

reasons: Ox opposes Goat — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: a lift with someone in it
signs.message: Someone's already riding up. Take the stairs, skip the pleasantries.
